title: Fit a random-feature spatial factor model to binned transcripts — fit_spatial_rff
text: **Experimental.** Segmentation-free model transcript counts. -tissue bin `b` (centre `u_b`, area ``) gene `j`, $$y_{bj} \sim \mathrm{Poisson\ \ NB}(\mu_{bj}), \quad   \log\mu_{bj} = \log + \alpha_j + \sigma_0 f_0(u_b) + \sum_{k=1}^K L_{jk} f_k(u_b),$$ \(f_0\) cellularity field shared genes \(f_1,\dots,f_K\) spatial factors. field Gaussian process RBF covariance \(\exp(-h^2/2\ell_k^2)\) approximated random Fourier features, \(f_k(u) = \phi_{\ell_k}(u)^\top\gamma_k\) \(\phi_\ell(u) = M^{-1/2}[\cos(\Omega u/\ell), \sin(\Omega u/\ell)]\), \(\Omega \sim N(0, )\) \(\gamma_k \sim N(0, )\) (Gundersen et al. 2021, coordinates observed inputs). Loadings, weights, length scales dispersions estimated jointly MAP closed-form gradients (L-BFGS-B).
